attchmntText: Orient Bell Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Orient Bell Limited has uploaded the audio recording of its post-earnings call for the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call was held on 13.11.2026 at 04:00 P.M. IST. The recording is available via the provided link and on the company website under Investor Relations disclosures. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Orient Bell Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Orient Bell Limited filed an investor presentation under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015 for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The presentation highlights consolidated financial results for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations increased by 38.8% year-on-year to Rs. 229 crores. Sales volume rose by 14.6% to 67 lakhs square meters. EBITDA margin expanded to 9.8% from 6.0% in the previous year. Profit before tax grew by 326.1% to Rs. 16.4 crores. Profit after tax increased by 288.6% to Rs. 12.4 crores. The company reported negative net debt of Rs. 48.8 crores. The cash conversion cycle stood at 18 days. The share of premium vitrified tiles increased to 59%. Glazed vitrified products accounted for 45% of sales.

attchmntText: Orient Bell Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Orient Bell Limited has submitted its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these standalone and consolidated results, along with Limited Review Reports from Statutory Auditors, during a meeting held on Friday, 13th November, 2026. The meeting commenced at 12:02 P.M. and concluded at 1:54 P.M. The company will upload the financial results on its website, www.orientbell.com. Additionally, the Quick Response Code and details of the webpage containing the complete financial results will be published in newspapers for investor access. This submission is made pursuant to Regulations 30, 33, 46, and 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
